description: Source code for the VariantBuilder class in Apache Spark, responsible for building variant values and metadata by parsing JSON data, including methods for appending various data types, handling JSON parsing, and constructing variant objects and arrays.

classes.name: VariantBuilder
classes.description: Class for constructing variant data structures by parsing JSON input, supporting appending various data types, handling JSON tokens, and building complex nested variants.

classes.name: VariantBuilder.FieldEntry
classes.description: Helper class representing a key-value pair with an offset used during JSON object processing.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Variant object, with an option to allow duplicate keys.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON using a JsonParser object into a Variant, with an option to allow duplicate keys.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final Variant object with metadata.

methods.name: valueWithoutMetadata
methods.description: Returns the variant value bytes without metadata, used in shredding.

methods.name: appendString
methods.description: Appends a UTF-8 encoded string to the variant buffer.

methods.name: appendNull
methods.description: Appends a null value to the variant buffer.

methods.name: appendBoolean
methods.description: Appends a boolean value to the variant buffer.

methods.name: appendLong
methods.description: Appends a long integer, choosing the smallest suitable integer type.

methods.name: appendDouble
methods.description: Appends a double-precision floating point value.

methods.name: appendDecimal
methods.description: Appends a BigDecimal value, encoding based on precision and scale.

methods.name: appendDate
methods.description: Appends a date value as days since epoch.

methods.name: appendTimestamp
methods.description: Appends a timestamp value in microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: appendTimestampNtz
methods.description: Appends a timestamp with no time zone.

methods.name: appendFloat
methods.description: Appends a float value.

methods.name: appendBinary
methods.description: Appends binary data.

methods.name: appendUuid
methods.description: Appends a UUID value.

methods.name: addKey
methods.description: Adds a key to the dictionary, returning its id.

methods.name: getWritePos
methods.description: Returns the current write position in the buffer.

methods.name: finishWritingObject
methods.description: Finalizes an object, sorting fields, handling duplicates, and writing headers.

methods.name: finishWritingArray
methods.description: Finalizes an array, writing headers and offsets.

methods.name: appendVariant
methods.description: Appends a nested Variant, inserting keys into the dictionary.

methods.name: shallowAppendVariant
methods.description: Appends a Variant value directly without metadata processing.
